senses.gloss: ch. same, to be angry, sensitive; to be particular, care for, mind.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 107a:6">Ḥull. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>קַפְדִּיתוּ אמנא</he> are you particular about the condition of the vessel (used for ablution)? <cite ref="Chullin 107a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אמנא ואחזותא קַפְדִּינָן</he> we are particular about the vessel and about the color (of the water), <he>אשיעורא לא קַפְדִּינָן</he> we are not so about the quantity.

<cite ref="Shabbat 147a:1">Sabb. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>והוא דקָפֵיד עלייהו</he> provided a person is particular about his garments’ being shaken before he puts them on; <he>אנן לא קפדינן</he> we do not care about it.
<cite ref="Pesachim 110b:2">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>כל דקפיד קָפְדֵּי בהדיה וכ׳</he> he that minds (such practices) is strictly dealt with (suffers for disregarding them); he that does not care &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:11">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>דקפיד אמנא שד</he> a magician that is particular about the vessel he uses is a conjurer of demons; a. fr.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S01699">same</cite>. Y. Sabb. I, 4ᵃ top <he>מְקַפְּדִין</he>, v. <cite ref="S00606"><he>קוּרְיָיאָה</he></cite>

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 38:12">Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>איתקפלו</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 2:7">Targ. Mic. II, 7</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be angry, excited. Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ top שמע … וא׳ עילוי Samuel heard of it and was angry with him.
to provoke, insult. Y. B. Kam. VIII, end, 6ᶜ חד בר נש א׳ לר׳ וכ׳ (not איק׳) a man insulted R. Ḥ.
